hero.title: Run a doujin convention end to end
hero.body: Circles apply and pay, organizers review and allocate booths, attendees buy tickets, and staff scan them at the door — including when the venue wifi drops.

events.title: Events
events.emptyBody: Published events appear here. Organizers also see their own drafts once they sign in.

flow.title: How an event runs
flow.applyBody: One application form with a saved draft, a circle cut, and payment.
flow.allocateBody: Work the review queue, accept or waitlist, then place booths on the floor plan.
flow.sellBody: Tiers per day, priced by the server, with one QR pass per admitted person.
flow.scanBody: Scans queue on the device when the wifi drops and reconcile on reconnect.
